emailHint: The same email you used when you registered it.
sent: If the details match, you'll receive an email with a sign-in link in a few minutes. The link works once and expires in 30 minutes. Please check your spam folder too.
invalid: Please check the code and email.
busy: You've made several attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
unavailable: We couldn't send the link right now. Try again in a few minutes or message us on WhatsApp.
expired: This link has already been used or has expired. Request a new one below.
linkNotFound: This link isn't valid. Request a new one below.
privacy: For your security, we never show booking or complaint details without verifying your email.

booking.title: Access my booking
booking.description: Get a secure link by email to view your booking, your voucher and pay the balance.
booking.intro: Enter your booking code and the email you booked with. We'll send you a secure link to open it.
booking.tokenText: Press the button to open your booking in this browser. The link works only once.

complaint.title: Check my complaint
complaint.description: Check the status and response of your complaint form with a secure link sent to your email.
complaint.intro: Enter your complaint form code and the email you registered. We'll send you a secure link to view it.
complaint.tokenText: Press the button to view your complaint form in this browser. The link works only once.
complaint.notFound: We couldn't open this form in this browser. Request a new link with your code and email.
complaint.noAnswer: No response yet. We'll reply through the channel you chose within the legal deadline.
